Chapter 6544: Peerless Immortal

Chapter 6544: Peerless Immortal

The ancient language of an immortal alone could destroy a world from a far distance. Inhabitants of Three Immortals found themselves trapped in a hut during a torrential storm.

Calamitious Edge swung again, cutting through the primordial waves to see the origin of all things.

The emergence of an immortal signaled the beginning of all things, celebrated by primordial light. This point contained the powers, weight, and toughness of epochs.

Alas, the blade needed no technique or dao. Its sharpness overcame all mysteries and laws, this source included.

Saber users at the primal ancestor level found themselves to be children playing with toys in comparison. Her unique saber dao left all saber practitioners in utter shame. Their techniques weren’t worthy of being called dao.

Once the source was cut, all affinities rushed out like a flood breaking the dam, roaming to the past, present, and future.

Calamitious Edge moved once more at a swift beyond discernment. Black and Xian Chengtian couldn’t see its movements.

Countless beings were struck with horror, unable to describe the technique. They saw visions of Three Immortals torn apart into fragments.

“Madness.” Xian Chengtian murmured.

No one knew how many times Desolate Ancestor had swung to give off this apocalyptic feeling. This moment felt like an eternity with everyone trembling on the ground.

Eventually, the mad flurry of slashes ceased and normalcy returned. When people looked up, they saw the sky of Three Immortals still intact.

Both the primordial waves and the mad slashes never made it here. Desolate Ancestor purposely nullified everything.

Although nothing was directly struck, some were scared out of their wits and died from it.

Powerful cultivators began looking at the aftermath. They saw continents of Corpse Wasteland falling into their original position in Uncrossable Expanse and causing tidal waves.

“Desolate Immortal.” An overlord commented.

Amidst killing an immortal violently, she didn’t damage Corpse Wasteland at all. This was completely different from the destruction caused by Skyfire Phoenix’s legion and Black earlier.

Although it wasn’t to the level of Li Qiye reversing the timeline of an entire world, her mastery and precision were frightening.

“Improved again.” Weizhen became emotional.

His master, Zhan Sansheng, was the most devilish cultivator in history. He became an immortal in three lifetimes.

Because of this, he saw wondrous techniques before but this mad flurry still left him shaken. He could see that during his master’s absence, she had improved dramatically.

An immortal stood at the top of history. Taking the next step was virtually impossible but Desolate Ancestor had done it.

“She’ll catch up to the primordial immortals one day, perhaps not long from now.” He said in a daze.

The immortals who observed the fight were impressed as well. They feared nothing but her blade invoked this forgotten emotion.

There was a chance she would be able to kill a primordial immortal if this continued.

“An unsurpassable immortal.” Xian Chengtian didn’t know whether he was shocked or jealous. She was on another level even though he had three primordial immortals as his masters.
